required_evidence: Approved customer or business scope; named endpoint owner; permitted monitoring and action classes
pilot_test: Select one authorized Apple-silicon Mac and one Intel Mac where available
pass_criteria: Every pilot device and permitted action has a named owner and written scope
stop_condition: A technician must infer whether a device or action is authorized

required_evidence: Serial number; hardware UUID; hostname; assigned user; ownership; enrollment time
pilot_test: Rename the pilot Mac and confirm the management record remains the same device
pass_criteria: The record survives ordinary hostname and user changes without creating a duplicate
stop_condition: A routine identity change creates an unexplained second record

required_evidence: Signed package source; installer hash or signature evidence; install log; tenant and site assignment
pilot_test: Install through the approved delivery path on a clean representative Mac
pass_criteria: The correct tenant and site receive one healthy record with dated evidence
stop_condition: Enrollment is ambiguous; cross-tenant; duplicated; or requires broad unapproved permissions

required_evidence: Required Accessibility; Screen Recording; Full Disk Access; Files and Folders; Notification permissions with business purpose
pilot_test: Compare requested privacy permissions with the documented feature set
pass_criteria: Every requested permission has a documented purpose and approved deployment method
stop_condition: The agent requests unexplained or broader privacy access than the approved workflow needs

required_evidence: Matrix assigning profiles; FileVault; restrictions; applications; updates; certificates; scripts; remote support; and removal
pilot_test: Compare the RMM configuration with active MDM profiles on the pilot Mac
pass_criteria: Each control has one system of authority or an explicit coexistence rule
stop_condition: RMM and MDM can apply conflicting settings without detection or ownership

required_evidence: Model; architecture; serial; OS version and build; storage; memory; last check-in; source timestamp
pilot_test: Change one observable non-sensitive property and confirm the next inventory refresh
pass_criteria: Inventory is current; source-dated; and distinguishes Apple silicon from Intel
stop_condition: Inventory is stale; lacks an observation time; or merges unlike devices

required_evidence: Current or assigned user; ownership; login state; multi-user assumptions; privacy boundary
pilot_test: Test a standard-user session and a separate administrator session
pass_criteria: The record explains which user context is observed without exposing unnecessary personal data
stop_condition: Technicians cannot tell which user or privilege context an action used

required_evidence: LaunchDaemon or LaunchAgent identifiers; process state; version; last check-in; restart history
pilot_test: Stop only an approved test component and observe health detection and recovery
pass_criteria: Loss of the required component becomes owned work and recovery is evidenced
stop_condition: The agent can remain partially failed while the console reports healthy

required_evidence: Documented destinations; ports; DNS; proxy behavior; certificate validation; failure logs
pilot_test: Test normal access and one bounded blocked-path condition
pass_criteria: The failure is observable and recovery occurs without weakening TLS or proxy controls
stop_condition: Troubleshooting requires disabling certificate validation or broad network controls

required_evidence: Documented CPU; memory; disk; service; check-in; and OS-version signals with collection times
pilot_test: Create one reversible threshold condition on a pilot Mac
pass_criteria: The signal arrives with device identity; timestamp; severity; and owner
stop_condition: A threshold creates no work; duplicates work; or lacks device context

required_evidence: Routing rule; recipient or queue; acknowledgement; maintenance behavior; escalation path
pilot_test: Trigger one reversible alert and acknowledge it through the normal workflow
pass_criteria: One actionable item reaches the intended owner and closes only after recovery evidence
stop_condition: The alert is lost; duplicated; unactionable; or silently suppressed

required_evidence: Script source; signer or approval; execution user; timeout; output; exit code; audit event
pilot_test: Run a harmless read-only command as standard user and an approved privileged command if supported
pass_criteria: The execution identity; command; output; result; and time are attributable
stop_condition: The platform obscures execution privilege or accepts unbounded commands without evidence

required_evidence: Automation trigger; exact device scope; approval; timeout; stop rule; rollback or recovery action
pilot_test: Run an inactive or reversible automation against only the pilot group
pass_criteria: The intended pilot receives one bounded action and every result is recorded
stop_condition: The action can escape the pilot group or repeat without an observable stop condition

required_evidence: Available and installed update evidence; deferral owner; restart policy; MDM overlap; observation time
pilot_test: Observe update state before and after one approved update or documented deferral
pass_criteria: The final build; restart state; failure; and exception owner reconcile across systems
stop_condition: RMM and MDM disagree on update authority or the final build remains unknown

required_evidence: Application name; version; source; observation time; privacy exclusions; managed-app owner
pilot_test: Install or update one approved test application and observe inventory change
pass_criteria: The inventory change is timely and does not claim unsupported application-control authority
stop_condition: Inventory is stale; invasive; or confused with MDM-managed application policy

required_evidence: Attended or unattended policy; approver; technician identity; reason; start and end time; privacy permissions
pilot_test: Open one authorized pilot session and end it through the normal workflow
pass_criteria: The user-consent model and technician identity match policy and the session is auditable
stop_condition: A session starts outside approved consent; scope; or audit requirements

required_evidence: Connection path; display state; keyboard mapping; clipboard and file-transfer policy; reconnect result
pilot_test: Exercise an approved low-risk support task and one normal disconnect
pass_criteria: The task succeeds within policy and the session terminates without persistent unintended access
stop_condition: The session leaves access active; bypasses policy; or cannot prove closure

required_evidence: Agent signature; process and path inventory; security alert results; narrow exception record if required
pilot_test: Install and operate the RMM agent with the production security stack on a pilot Mac
pass_criteria: Normal RMM activity works while altered or unapproved activity remains detectable
stop_condition: Success requires a broad permanent exclusion or disabling security telemetry

required_evidence: System of authority; encryption-status source; recovery-key handling boundary; observation time
pilot_test: Compare reported state with the approved FileVault system of record
pass_criteria: RMM visibility is accurately scoped and never stores recovery secrets in the worksheet
stop_condition: The platform implies recovery-key control it does not own or exposes key material

required_evidence: Technician; tenant; device; action; timestamp; result; source IP or session where supported; retention
pilot_test: Export or review the pilot actions performed in this evaluation
pass_criteria: A reviewer can reconstruct who did what; where; when; and with what result
stop_condition: Privileged actions cannot be attributed or exported for the required retention

required_evidence: Tenant; customer; site; role; and scope evidence; cross-tenant negative test
pilot_test: Confirm a technician scoped to one pilot customer cannot view or act on another
pass_criteria: Unauthorized cross-tenant data and actions are denied and logged
stop_condition: Customer boundaries depend only on technician habit or naming conventions

required_evidence: Last check-in; queued-action policy; sleep and wake behavior; stale threshold; duplicate prevention
pilot_test: Sleep; wake; and temporarily disconnect the pilot Mac
pass_criteria: State becomes stale honestly; queued work is bounded; and reconnect creates no duplicate
stop_condition: Offline state appears healthy or queued actions execute unexpectedly after reconnect

required_evidence: Authorized uninstall method; process and file checks; privacy-profile cleanup; remote-access revocation; final console state
pilot_test: Remove the pilot agent using the supported method and verify residual access
pass_criteria: Required services and access are gone; the console state is explicit; and evidence is retained
stop_condition: Remote access; services; profiles; or credentials remain active without an owner

required_evidence: Completed evidence links; failed controls; accepted risk; remediation owners; due dates; retest dates; approver
pilot_test: Hold a go or no-go review using this matrix
pass_criteria: Every failed control blocks rollout or has explicit time-bounded acceptance and ownership
stop_condition: The rollout expands with unexplained gaps; missing evidence; or ownerless exceptions
